personality: Fusion of 6 Glass / Luxe (Structure & Glass) + 7 Dark-First Utility (Metrics & Layout)
personality_one_liner: A stunning, high-end audiophile experience merging the nostalgic tactile feedback of an iPod click wheel with Vision Pro-style dark glassmorphism.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for glass elements. Safe areas strictly enforced. Padding inside cards should let text breathe.

do's: Use glass heavily for the Click Wheel center button, tab bar, and EQ cards.
Add a translucent tinted base underneath blur for readability (≥75% opacity of surface in dark mode).
Apply gradient-to-dark scrim over any full-bleed background imagery.
dont's: Do not use blur on body text regions or form fields.
Never place thin serif typography directly on noisy imagery without a scrim.

screens.name: Player (Home)
screens.purpose: Primary music playback interface featuring the iconic Chrome Click Wheel and Now Playing details.

states.empty: No active track. Shows default vinyl record art and prompts to select a folder.
states.error: Failed to load audio. Retry button in glass pill.

screens.layout: Screen background uses a deeply blurred atmospheric photo (misty glass) overlaid with a dark gradient scrim (Layer 0). Top area contains the Album Art rendered as a large square with soft rounded corners inside a glass frame. Below it: Track Title (marquee if long) and Artist Name. Below that: the Timeline scrubber. Bottom half is entirely dominated by the Click Wheel: a large circular component. The outer ring has an 'expo-linear-gradient' giving a metallic/chrome appearance. 4 directional labels (MENU, ⏮, ⏭, ⏯) sit on the ring. The center button is a deeply blurred glass circle (expo-blur) with a subtle inset shadow. The bottom tab bar is absolutely positioned glass over the wheel's lower edge.

screens.name: Folders
screens.purpose: Browse Android storage to pick a folder and play all tracks inside.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty file cabinet, 'No folders found'.
states.error: Storage permission denied message with a primary CTA 'Grant Permission'.

screens.layout: Large serif title 'Storage'. A pinned 'Recently Played' section at the top with a horizontal scrolling row of glass cards. Below, a vertical list of folders. Each folder row uses a brandTertiary-tinted icon container (folder icon) next to the folder name and track count. Tapping a folder pushes to a 'Folder Detail' view (List of tracks, tapping one starts playback and navigates back to Player).

screens.name: Equalizer
screens.purpose: Advanced parametric equalizer with customizable bands and EqualizerAPO integration.
screens.layout: Large serif title 'Parametric EQ'. Top section: A rich glass card displaying the Frequency Response Graph (using a bright brandPrimary line charting the curve). Middle section: A horizontal ScrollView of pill-shaped preset buttons (Flat, Rock, Bass Boost, Custom). Lower section: A vertical list of EQ Bands. Each band is a glass card containing a dropdown for Filter Type (Peak, High-Shelf, etc.) and 3 sliders for Freq (Hz), Gain (dB), and Q-Factor. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom to 'Import .txt Config'.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Manage app preferences, permissions, and view about info.
screens.layout: Simple vertical list of glassmorphic rows. Sections for 'Permissions', 'Theme', and 'About'. Each row has a left icon inside a tinted rounded square container, title, and right chevron. Standard bottom tab bar navigation.

haptics.click_wheel_scroll: selection (light, repeated rapidly during circular drag)

default_album_art.alt: Vintage black and white vinyl record cover

hero_background.alt: Atmospheric mist on glass window used as blurred backdrop

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Adhere to the <Glassmorphism_and_Blur> rules. Use expo-blur over translucent surfaceSecondary/Tertiary layers to create depth. The click wheel center button must be glass.
CRITICAL: The click wheel outer ring MUST use `expo-linear-gradient` to simulate a chrome metallic reflection. Use stops like #404050, #A0A0AB, #2A2A35 to create a shiny metallic ring.

CRITICAL: Implement circular gesture recognition using react-native-gesture-handler on the click wheel ring. Map the angle changes to volume or track scrolling. Trigger light haptics repeatedly as the angle changes.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use blue, indigo, or purple. Stick to the provided dark obsidian colors and the amber (#F59E0B) brand color.
CRITICAL: Use Fraunces for large headers (like Equalizer, Folders) to give a high-end audiophile/luxury vibe, but use Switzer for all body text and metrics.
CRITICAL: The Equalizer screen requires complex UI. Use Reanimated for smooth slider interactions. Ensure the parametric EQ bands have 3 parameters each: Freq, Gain, Q-factor.
CRITICAL: Always use a vertical gradient scrim (Layer 0) beneath text that sits on top of images or blurred backgrounds.
Ensure 'Storage' permission logic correctly navigates Android 13+ media storage scopes, as this is a core requirement for the folder browser.
Make sure the 4 corner buttons on the Click Wheel (MENU, Prev, Next, Play/Pause) act as real discrete tap zones overlaid on the ring.
